# Always Summer (Кайт-Лето) — kitesurfing school in Vietnam

> Kitesurfing school in Vietnam since 2013. Lessons in Mui Ne (Nov–Mar), Phan Rang (Nov–Apr) and Nha Trang (May–Sep) with a personal instructor; all equipment included. Lessons in English or Russian. Head instructor: Alexander Kovalenko (Александр Коваленко), IKO Level 3, 1,000+ hours of teaching. In Mui Ne the school is based at C2Sky Kite Center.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2013
- Spots and seasons: Mui Ne — November to March (best January to March, average wind 8–12 m/s / 16–23 knots); Phan Rang — November to April (9–15 m/s / 17–29 knots, flat shallow lagoon); Nha Trang — May to September (6–8 m/s / 12–16 knots, thermal wind)
- Prices (per person, personal instructor and all equipment included): intro lesson 2 hours — €120; basic course 6 hours / 3 days — €350; full course 10 hours / 5 days — €500
- Sessions: 2 hours a day; most beginners need about 10 hours to ride on their own
- Certificate: IKO after the course
- Google Maps rating: 4.8 (26 reviews): https://maps.google.com/?cid=973584323309026948
- Mui Ne base location: 10.9409, 108.1940 (at C2Sky Kite Center)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aleksandr_always_leto/
- Contacts: WhatsApp +1 631 575 4858 · Telegram @kifesurf · kiteleto2010@gmail.com
